parsed.internal_thinking: I rolled a 2 (Snake Eyes), which produced nothing for anyone. My goal is to reach Node 9 for the 3:1 port. I currently have 1 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep, plus a Monopoly card. Charlie has 3 Wood. Bob has 3 Wheat and 2 Wood. Since I lack Brick to build a road towards Node 9, and no one has Brick to trade, I will use my Monopoly card on Wheat. Bob is sitting on heavy Wheat production (Hex 7, 14, 18) and I know he has at least 3. Charlie might have some too. This will give me enough Wheat to either trade with the bank or use for future builds. After the Monopoly, I'll see if I can secure a trade for Brick.
parsed.note_to_self: Used Monopoly on Wheat. Bob was the primary target due to his 3 Wheat. Need to convert this Wheat into Brick to reach the 3:1 port at Node 9.
parsed.say_outloud: Well, since the dice aren't giving us much to work with, I think I'll take matters into my own hands. Bob, you've been talking about keeping the wheat flowing... I'll take that quite literally.
